name: Astrid y Gastón
summary: The historic Lima fine-dining name, in a colonial hacienda with a theatrical tasting menu (tableside pisco sour, cuy Pekinés, bread flight, chocolate box). Best for a polished, playful celebratory meal; Reddit often suggests it as the more relaxed, easier-to-book alternative to Central, Maido or Kjolle, and some prefer à la carte or lunch for value.

value.text: Tue-Sat lunch about 13:00-16:00 and dinner 19:00-23:00; Sunday lunch only; closed Monday.
Seasonal tasting about S/748 (~US$220) before drinks; wine pairing S/599 (~US$175). Prices not published on the official site.
